title: An inventory
description:
Keep an inventory of items with quantities and commands.

```
> add sword 1
> add potion 3
> use potion
potion: 2 left
> use shield
You have no shield
> list
potion 2
sword 1
> quit
```

starter.main.lua:
local items = {}
while true do
  io.write("> ")
  local line = io.read()
  if not line or line == "quit" then break end
  local command, name, count = line:match("^(%a+)%s*(%a*)%s*(%d*)$")
  -- TODO
end

hints: Collect the names in a list, `table.sort` it, and print each with its count.
requirements: The inventory is a table from item name to count.
`use` takes one away and removes the item at 0 (set it to `nil`).
stretch: Give each item a weight and refuse to add more than 20 total.
